user.title: Integration setup
user.description: Enter your PRIM API key to access IDFM data.

search_stop_area.title: Search for a stop
search_stop_area.description: Enter at least 3 characters to search for a stop (e.g. 'Nation', 'Gare de Lyon').

select_stop_area.title: Stop selection
select_stop_area.description: Pick a stop from the list. You can also customise the sensor name (optional).

main_menu.title: Main menu
main_menu.description: What would you like to do?

search_line.title: Search for a line
search_line.description: Choose a transport mode, then enter a line code (e.g. {placeholder}). The code is required with the 'Location' mode.

select_line.title: Line selection
select_line.description: Pick the line to create a disruption messages sensor for.

delete.title: Delete a sensor
delete.description: Select the sensor to permanently delete.

refresh_settings.title: Refresh interval
refresh_settings.description: Interval between two PRIM calls, in seconds (min {min_interval}, max {max_interval}). One request is made per stop and per cycle: 180 s ≈ 480 calls/day. Night pause skips calls between 01:30 and 05:30 while the network is closed.

reauth_confirm.title: PRIM API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The stored PRIM API key is no longer accepted. Enter a new key to restore the connection.

error.invalid_api_key: The provided API key is invalid.
error.api_key_empty: The API key cannot be empty.
error.empty_code: A line code is required with the 'Location' mode.
error.invalid_selection: The selection is not valid, please try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the PRIM service.
abort.invalid_api_key: The provided API key is invalid.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key has been updated.
